reference: User-supplied cat-clock photograph used for product-photo material and movement reference only; source photograph and logos are not shipped.
prompts:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: transparent animated web clock asset, portrait 1024x1536.
Input image: reference only for glossy black vintage cat wall clock product photography, not an exact copy.
Primary request: Create an original unbranded black cat pendulum wall clock, straight-on orthographic product photograph, isolated on genuinely transparent background. Glossy black molded lacquer body with large round head, two pointed ears, enormous ivory oval eyeballs, SMALL black vertical pupils looking straight ahead, subtle small ivory smiling muzzle, tiny black nose. Body is seated upright, paws on either side of the belly, a large perfectly ROUND matte warm ivory clock face centered on belly with simple black 1 through 12 hour numerals, NO HANDS and no center pin (hands added by website). Thin brass rim. Narrow dark green collar and small brass bell under chin. No bow tie. Long black pendulum tail hanging STRAIGHT down from center below the body, with rounded slightly curved tip. Distinct sculptural proportions and friendly understated expression. Whole body above y=1040, long tail below y=1040 to y=1480. Head occupies top 40%, clock dial middle body. Plenty of transparent room to sides for tail swinging. Entire object including tail and ears visible, full length centered, symmetrical front view, no tilt. Photorealistic glossy dimensional object with soft studio highlights, not illustration or fur or cartoon drawing. Strong ivory-black contrast, premium vintage toy photography.
Constraints: no manufacturer logos, no words, no watermarks. Do not copy reference smile markings, trademark face, bowtie or branded dial. Keep head stationary and tail straight so website can animate eyes and tail separately. Transparent background, no floor or cast shadow.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the provided original black glossy cat clock transparent asset.
Change ONLY the two black vertical pupils: remove the pupils entirely and fill those small areas naturally with matching smooth ivory glossy eyeball, leaving EMPTY ivory oval eyeballs. The website will add moving pupils.
Keep every other pixel as close as possible: same black glossy sculptural cat, head and ears, facial proportions, friendly smile, green collar and brass bell, round ivory belly clock with all 12 numerals and no hands, straight hanging tail, exact front-facing position and 1024x1536 composition. Preserve the genuinely transparent background and alpha. Do not add any background or shadows, no logo, no text except the existing clock numerals. This is an animation asset preparation edit, not a redesign.
animation: Website layers the generated tail under a masked body, adds moving pupils to the empty eyes and rotates hands over the blank clock face. The original companion art is unchanged.
